# Cncf Orka Reviewer

Review Orka using its official documentation and repository in the Platform / Certified Kubernetes - Hosted category. Orka is a platform that allows Orchestration via Kubernetes on Apple. It allows MacOS on genuine Apple hardware to be used in Kubernetes.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
